title: $69.99 model has glaring design defect
text: $69.99 model has glaring design defect. Look closely and see the deep scarring pattern from the neck to the chest. No Buddha statue has this glaring defect. Not until I paid $69.99 + tax and receive this 'carney' type statue did I see the horrible quality of workmanship. I was told I could return it, but I am disabled and a senior and with the 'Stay-At-Home order in my State so I can't. Expensive lesson learned. Look 'closely' at the photos. This is not a John Timberland fountain with such ugly cracks by the neck.

product_metadata.title: Universal Lighting and Decor Meditating Buddha Asian Zen Indoor Table-Top Water Fountain with Light LED 17 1/4" High for Table Desk Office Home Bedroom Relaxation - John Timberland
description: This distinctive fountain will add a special beauty to your indoor spaces. The classic seated Buddha design offers "zen" appeal along with the calming sound of running water to living areas and workspaces. The fountain is illuminated by LED clusters for increased visual appeal. LED Lighting Antique bronze finish. Lightweight resin construction. LED lighting. For indoor use only. Includes 9' power cord. 19" high. 13" wide. 13" deep.
